Package com.datastax.dse.driver.api.core.metadata.schema

Interface DseTableMetadata

  • All Superinterfaces:
    Describable, DseRelationMetadata, RelationMetadata, TableMetadata
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    DseGraphTableMetadata
    public interface DseTableMetadata
extends DseRelationMetadata, TableMetadata
    Specialized table metadata for DSE.

    Notes:

    • this type can always be safely downcast to DseGraphTableMetadata (the only reason the two interfaces are separate is for backward compatibility).
    • all returned ColumnMetadata can be cast to DseColumnMetadata, and all IndexMetadata to DseIndexMetadata.
